methods.label: Choose an input that reveals the constant
methods.explanation:
The identity holds at every allowed input, so choose \(x=-3\), which makes \(f(-3)=c\). It follows that
\[
f(c)=-3.
\]
In particular, \(c\ne-\frac32\), since this function value must be defined. Substituting the formula for \(f(c)\) and multiplying by the nonzero denominator gives
\[
\frac{c^2}{2c+3}=-3
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
c^2+6c+9=0.
\]
Thus \((c+3)^2=0\), so the only possible value is \(c=-3\).

We must check that this value works for every required input. If \(c=-3\) and \(x\ne-\frac32\), then
\[
f(x)=\frac{-3x}{2x+3},
\qquad
2f(x)+3=\frac9{2x+3}\ne0.
\]
The second formula shows that \(f(x)\) never equals the excluded input \(-\frac32\), so the composition is always defined. Moreover,
\[
f(f(x))
=\frac{-3f(x)}{2f(x)+3}
=\frac{9x/(2x+3)}{9/(2x+3)}
=x.
\]
Therefore \(c=-3\), choice A.
